parsed.post: Keeping the recent improvement (1.034885). The reduction to AR 32 seems to be helping performance on this depth 6 branch. Next, I will test increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.1 to see if stronger regularization helps stabilize this deeper, narrower configuration.
parsed.description: Increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.1 to improve regularization for the D6/AR32 configuration.
